meta.name: apple-hig-expert
meta.description: Audits and designs iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS interfaces against the Apple Human Interface Guidelines, including the Liquid Glass design language (announced WWDC25, shipped with iOS 26/macOS Tahoe, Sept 2025). Use when reviewing an Apple-platform mockup or app for HIG compliance, checking contrast or tap-target sizes, or designing native-feeling Apple UI (e.g., 'audit my iOS app against the HIG', 'is this text readable on Liquid Glass?').

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照苹果人机界面指南审核和设计各平台界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为苹果平台设计或审核界面，需要确保符合HIG规范。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and design Apple platform interfaces against HIG guidelines.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing Apple platform interfaces and need HIG compliance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对照 Apple 人机界面指南(HIG)审核 iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS 界面,包括 Liquid Glass 设计语言;能运行脚本测量文字对比度和点击目标大小,按 100 分制扣分,并给出修改建议(如改用语义色、把点击区域扩到 44×44pt)。
howto.when: 当你要求审核某个 Apple 平台界面是否符合 HIG、检查文字对比度或点击目标大小、或设计原生 Apple 风格界面时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个iOS界面,按HIG打分
say.note: 启动审计模式,生成评分报告和违规列表

say.text: 用脚本检查下#8E8E93和#FFFFFF的对比度
say.note: 返回对比度数值及是否通过4.5:1标准

say.text: 这个按钮只有32x32pt,符合规范吗?
say.note: 检查点击目标是否达到44x44pt最小值

howto.what_en: Audits and designs Apple-platform interfaces (iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS) against the HIG, including Liquid Glass. Can run scripts to measure contrast ratio and tap-target size, score out of 100, and suggest fixes (e.g., semantic colors, 44x44pt hit regions).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit an Apple-platform mockup/app for HIG compliance, check contrast or tap-target sizes, or design native-feeling Apple UI.

say_en.text: Audit this iOS screen against the HIG and score it
say_en.note: Starts audit mode, returns score and violations
Shows ratio and whether it passes 4.5:1
